Meeting Date:                 3/24/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Reilly (42)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-F at 100 W Randolph St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards;
                                                       CityCouncil Meeting, March 24, 2021
                                                       Aldernian Brendan Reilly, 42nd Ward

                                     ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

    SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code. the Chicago; Zoning Ordinancei is hereby
amended by changing all the Business Planned Development No. 270 symbols and indications
shown on Map 1-F in the area bounded by:-

       West Lake Street, North Clark Street, West Randolph Street, and North LaSalle Street

to the designation ofthe DC-16, Downtown Core District.

   SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.




                                                                           BRENDAN REILLY^
                                                                        Alderman, 42nd Vyan




Address:      100 W. Randolph Street
